```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

source("../../config/paths.R")

experiment_name <- "gt_100taxa_alpha2_beta1_prior" # edit to reflect simulation settings

paths <- make_run_paths(experiment_name)

sim_data_path <- file.path(
  paths$sim_data_dir,
  paste0(experiment_name, "_sim_data.rds")
)

sim_data_dir <- paths$sim_data_dir
```


# Purpose

This file creates/loads the dataset used for the BEAST runs. It simulates:

- a coalescent tree
- tip generation-time observations under a Brownian phylogenetic model plus residual error
- a neutral JC69 sequence alignment on the same tree

Later, here will be the place to import real data instead of the simulation.

# Settings

```{r settings}
rerun_simulation <- TRUE

ntips <- 100
sequence_length <- 50000
jc_clock_rate <- 0.05

set_seed <- 1

true_intercept <- 5

prior_beta_mean <- 0
prior_beta_variance <- 1000

prior_brownian_variance_alpha <- 2
prior_brownian_variance_beta <- 1

prior_residual_variance_alpha <- 2
prior_residual_variance_beta <- 1
```

# Packages

```{r packages}
library(ape)
library(MCMCglmm)
library(phytools)
```

# Function for JC69 sequence simulation

```{r helpers}
rinvgamma <- function(n, alpha, beta) {
  beta / rgamma(n, shape = alpha, rate = 1)
}

simulate_jc69_alignment <- function(tree, sequence_length = 1000, rate = 0.01) {

  states <- c("A", "C", "G", "T")
  n_nodes <- length(tree$tip.label) + tree$Nnode

  sequences <- vector("list", n_nodes)

  root_node <- length(tree$tip.label) + 1
  sequences[[root_node]] <- sample(states, sequence_length, replace = TRUE)

  children_by_parent <- split(tree$edge[, 2], tree$edge[, 1])
  branch_length_by_child <- setNames(tree$edge.length, tree$edge[, 2])

  evolve_from_node <- function(parent_node) {

    children <- children_by_parent[[as.character(parent_node)]]

    if (is.null(children)) {
      return(invisible(NULL))
    }

    for (child_node in children) {

      parent_sequence <- sequences[[parent_node]]
      child_sequence <- parent_sequence

      branch_length <- branch_length_by_child[as.character(child_node)]

      change_probability <- 0.75 * (
        1.0 - exp(-4.0 * rate * branch_length / 3.0)
      )

      changed_sites <- which(runif(sequence_length) < change_probability)

      for (site in changed_sites) {
        child_sequence[site] <- sample(
          states[states != parent_sequence[site]],
          1
        )
      }

      sequences[[child_node]] <<- child_sequence
      evolve_from_node(child_node)
    }

    invisible(NULL)
  }

  evolve_from_node(root_node)

  tip_sequences <- vapply(
    seq_along(tree$tip.label),
    function(tip_index) paste(sequences[[tip_index]], collapse = ""),
    character(1)
  )

  names(tip_sequences) <- tree$tip.label
  tip_sequences
}
```

# Simulate

```{r simulate}
if (rerun_simulation || !file.exists(sim_data_path)) {

  set.seed(set_seed)

  tree <- rcoal(ntips)

  true_v_phylo <- rinvgamma(
    1,
    alpha = prior_brownian_variance_alpha,
    beta = prior_brownian_variance_beta
  )
  
  true_v_resid <- rinvgamma(
    1,
    alpha = prior_residual_variance_alpha,
    beta = prior_residual_variance_beta
  )

  u_true <- rbv(
    tree,
    G = true_v_phylo,
    nodes = "TIPS"
  )

  e_true <- rnorm(
    ntips,
    mean = true_intercept,
    sd = sqrt(true_v_resid)
  )

  y <- u_true + e_true
  names(y) <- tree$tip.label

  dna_sequences <- simulate_jc69_alignment(
    tree = tree,
    sequence_length = sequence_length,
    rate = jc_clock_rate
  )

  sim_data <- list(
    tree = tree,
    y = y,
    dna_sequences = dna_sequences,
    true_values = data.frame(
      parameter = c("intercept", "v_phylo", "v_resid", "jc_clock_rate"),
      value = c(true_intercept, true_v_phylo, true_v_resid, jc_clock_rate)
    ),
    prior = list(
      beta_mean = prior_beta_mean,
      beta_variance = prior_beta_variance,
      brownian_variance_alpha = prior_brownian_variance_alpha,
      brownian_variance_beta = prior_brownian_variance_beta,
      residual_variance_alpha = prior_residual_variance_alpha,
      residual_variance_beta = prior_residual_variance_beta
    ),
    settings = list(
      experiment_name = experiment_name,
      ntips = ntips,
      sequence_length = sequence_length,
      jc_clock_rate = jc_clock_rate,
      set_seed = set_seed
    )
  )

  saveRDS(sim_data, sim_data_path)

} else {

  sim_data <- readRDS(sim_data_path)
}

str(sim_data, max.level = 2)
sim_data$true_values
cat("\nSaved simulation data:\n", sim_data_path, "\n")
```

# Plot simulated tree & tip data

```{r plot}

tree_plot <- sim_data$tree
gt_tip <- sim_data$y[tree_plot$tip.label]

# Scale bars
gt_tip_scaled <- gt_tip - min(gt_tip)
gt_tip_scaled <- gt_tip_scaled / max(gt_tip_scaled)

bar_scale <- 0.15
gt_tip_scaled <- gt_tip_scaled * bar_scale

phytools::plotTree.wBars(
  tree = tree_plot,
  x = gt_tip_scaled,
  type = "fan",
  tip.labels = FALSE,
  scale = 0.3,
  width = 0.25,
  col = "grey50",
  border = NA,
  ftype = "off"
)
```
